Due to the ongoing drainage pipeline work near Akbar Plaza building, Old Malakpet, traffic diversion continued up to 8:00 AM on 02-06-2025.

The Traffic coming from MGBS and Chadarghat Bridge will not be allowed to proceed towards Chaderghat ‘X’ Roads and Malakpet. 

The traffic coming from Koti, and Rangamahal through Chadarghat will not be allowed towards Chaderghat Rotary, Chaderghat Chota Bridge and Malakpet.

RTC buses coming from MGBS exit gate and proceeding towards Vijayawada, Suryapet, Nalgonda, Khammam traffic will be diverted at Chaderghat Rotary towards Chaderghat X Roads – Nimboliadda - Amberpet new flyover- Ramatapur – Uppal - LB Nagar, towards Vijayawada highway and also the Busses going to Kalwakurty, Dewarakonda, Srisailam, will be diverted through the same route only.

During traffic diversions, there might be traffic congestions at MJ Market, Koti, Rang Mahal  ‘X’ Roads, Chaderghat, SJ Rotary, Nimboliadda, Golnaka etc.  Hence, the commuters may choose alternate routes to reach their destinations.
